scope: Exact 125-file local onboarding public candidate, including hidden allowlisted files, structured strings, complete inventory and all checksums. External private policy applied. Git metadata and raw reviews stay outside the export.
copyright_notice: Maintainer-approved notice appears only in LICENSE.
governance: Independent project, administered by the maintainer; contributions do not grant approval or administrative authority.
external_dependencies: Declared, unbundled; distribution license metadata reviewed; no copied third-party code or media.
limitations: Pattern matching and manual review are bounded, not proof against every possible identifying encoding.
Dependency review covers declared Python distributions, not every upstream native component.
Public destination, final content and commit metadata still require explicit maintainer approval.
No installed host compatibility, real release authentication or universal assistant compliance is certified.
The official-documentation host allowlist is text audit policy only; it grants no authority or trust.
method: UTF-8 text, JSON value and Python literal inspection
Host paths, credentials, contacts and domain checks
No source history, dependencies, media or historical records packaged
Git index and commit payload must match the exact reviewed public inventory
